description: End-to-end coverage of the run metadata in the JSON report (ADR 01163): the run's `startedAt` and `environment`, each context's `startedAt`, `browser.version`, and `driver`, and each step's `startedAt`. A spec can't read its own report, because reporters run after every spec finishes, so each test seeds an inner spec, runs it through a nested `doc-detective` with `--output`, and asserts on the JSON it wrote. The asserting `node` is the same binary the nested run used, so `process.versions.node` and `os.release()` are the expected values. Scratch output goes to `.tmp/` at the repo root, never inside `test/core-artifacts/`.

tests.description: A shell-only run records the host environment and start times, and no browser or driver version. Runs on every platform.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.tmp/fixture-run-metadata/shell/report.json','utf8'));const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const iso=s=>typeof s==='string'&&new Date(s).toISOString()===s;const e=r.environment||{};if(!iso(r.startedAt))fail('run startedAt: '+r.startedAt);if(e.nodeVersion!==process.versions.node)fail('nodeVersion: '+e.nodeVersion);if(e.docDetectiveVersion!==require('./package.json').version)fail('docDetectiveVersion: '+e.docDetectiveVersion);if(e.osRelease!==os.release())fail('osRelease: '+e.osRelease);if(!e.platform||!e.arch)fail('platform or arch missing');if('workingDirectory' in e)fail('workingDirectory leaked into the report');const c=r.specs[0].tests[0].contexts[0];if(c.result!=='PASS')fail('inner context: '+c.result);if(!iso(c.startedAt)||c.startedAt<r.startedAt)fail('context startedAt: '+c.startedAt);if(c.driver||(c.browser&&c.browser.version))fail('browser metadata without a browser');if(c.steps.length!==2)fail('expected 2 steps');for(const s of c.steps)if(!iso(s.startedAt)||s.startedAt<c.startedAt)fail('step startedAt: '+s.startedAt);console.log('run-metadata ok: doc-detective '+e.docDetectiveVersion+', node '+e.nodeVersion+', '+e.platform+' '+e.arch+' '+e.osRelease)"

tests.description: A Chrome run records the browser and chromedriver versions the session reported. The opening `goTo` is the gate: it starts Chrome, so the test runs only where Chrome can start and lands SKIPPED elsewhere. Fallback is off, so it never substitutes another engine. Needs the test server on 8092.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.tmp/fixture-run-metadata/browser/report.json','utf8'));const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const iso=s=>typeof s==='string'&&new Date(s).toISOString()===s;const c=r.specs[0].tests[0].contexts[0];if(c.result!=='PASS')fail('inner context: '+c.result+' '+(c.resultDescription||''));const b=c.browser||{},v=c.driver||{};if(b.name!=='chrome'||typeof b.version!=='string'||!b.version)fail('browser: '+JSON.stringify(b));if(v.name!=='chromedriver'||typeof v.version!=='string'||!v.version)fail('driver: '+JSON.stringify(v));if(!iso(c.startedAt)||c.startedAt<r.startedAt)fail('context startedAt: '+c.startedAt);for(const s of c.steps)if(!iso(s.startedAt)||s.startedAt<c.startedAt)fail('step startedAt: '+s.startedAt);console.log('run-metadata browser ok: chrome '+b.version+', chromedriver '+v.version)"
